prompt: IMPORTANT: the white cat MUST REMAIN A REAL PHOTOGRAPHED CAT in every frame - individual hairs, natural fur, real whiskers, normal cat eyes. Never smooth, never glossy, never cartoonish, never a plush toy. It never turns into a person and stays the size of a grown adult human. Plain live television look: no sparks, no fire, no glowing effects, no cartoon effects. Nobody wears boxing gloves or MMA gloves - bare knuckles with thin hand wraps only, the cat's paws are bare fur. Anatomy stays correct: no twisted or inverted joints, no rubbery limbs, no extra limbs. Continuous single shot, no cuts, camera completely LOCKED on a tripod with only a tiny tremble; it does NOT zoom, push in, orbit or travel. Bare-knuckle boxing ring. Timing, follow it exactly: SECONDS 0-1: the fighter in blue shorts and the giant white cat stand at punching range, both fully visible. He sets his feet and throws a hard straight punch at the cat. SECONDS 1-2: without moving from its spot the cat calmly CATCHES HIS FIST in one open paw and holds it. The catch must be clearly visible - his fist stops dead inside the cat's paw. SECONDS 2-5: he tries to pull his hand free and cannot. He yanks backwards, twists, plants his foot against the canvas and pulls with his whole body - the cat does not move at all, does not brace, does not even look tense, it just holds him and blinks slowly. He never lands any punch on the cat. SECONDS 5-6: the cat simply lets go. He flies backwards from his own pulling, off balance, and drops COMPLETELY OUT OF THE FRAME - after that he is not visible at all. SECONDS 6-8: the cat is alone in frame, standing upright on its hind legs. It looks at the paw that caught the fist, licks it once, then raises it toward the roaring crowd and holds it. Shot on a long telephoto lens with shallow depth of field: the fighters and the ropes sharp, the crowd and the banners out of focus, no letters or logos legible behind the ring. The ring stays exactly as in the first frame. Do not invent or re-spell any text, no gibberish, no logos of any other fight promotion. Real fight speed, natural motion blur. Photorealistic. No blood, no injury, comedic tone. Audio: arena crowd, one sharp slap as the fist is caught, then the crowd murmuring and starting to laugh while he struggles, a thud as he goes down, then the crowd explodes. No music, no commentary, no speech.
